title: Access Onboarding Funnel & Weighted Priority Engine
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit many non-bug admin requests (RBAC role templates, SSO/SAML onboarding, SCIM provisioning, org policy exceptions). Current intake is inconsistent across channels, causing slow response times for high-risk requests and noisy operator queues for low-risk requests. Goals: 1) Create a deterministic, auditable intake funnel that standardizes signal capture (requestor context, org size, environment, legal/regulatory flags, prior activity). 2) Build a weighted priority engine that scores requests using configurable rules so high-risk/high-impact work is routed quickly (canary/exec lanes) while low-risk items follow self-serve or delegated flows. 3) Expose triage decisions and SLA expectations in the Console for transparency and to reduce duplicate ask. Scope: product + PM-led design + ENG adapter for routing rules and webhook integrations. Includes onboarding templates for SSO/SAML, RBAC role bundling presets, and SCIM provisioning validations. Out of scope for this ticket: implementing full RBAC enforcement in the runtime; that is a downstream engineering epic.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form schema defined and documented with required signals for scoring (requestor role, tenant size, business impact, PII/regulatory flag, requested change type).
Weighted priority engine spec with rule priorities and example datasets (low/medium/high) reviewed and approved by security and operations.
Routing matrix that maps score buckets to channels (self-serve, delegated admin, ops queue, executive SLA) documented in Console playbook.
Console mockups showing triage status badges, estimated SLA, and a trace link to the original request. UX validated by Design and Solutions Eng.
Event schema and webhook contract for ENG to implement routing hooks and to emit triage decisions to analytics.

Pilot plan for three customers (one large enterprise, one mid-market, one ISV) with success metrics defined (median time-to-resolution by bucket, percent automated assignments, reduction in duplicate requests).
implementation_notes: PM: run stakeholder interviews with support, sales engineering, security, and two enterprise customers to validate signals and thresholds.
Design: craft progressive disclosure intake UX and operator adjudication view; include inline help for SSO/SAML and SCIM fields.
Eng: implement routing rules as a small rules engine service (stateless) with test harness; provide webhook contract and staging endpoints.
Data/Analytics: instrument triage_score, source_channel, resolution_time; add runtime dashboard in Console with breakdown by bucket and team.
Security: schedule a security review for SSO/SAML onboarding flows and verify no secrets are captured in logs; coordinate KMS/HSM guidance for provisioning payloads.
Compliance: add audit-log requirements for all triage actions (who changed score, who routed, when) and include link to retention policy in Console docs.
Rollout: pilot as opt-in for dedicated customers; gather feedback and refine thresholds before global enablement.
Metrics: primary = median time-to-resolution for high-risk requests < 24 hours during pilot; secondary = 30% reduction in duplicates within 90 days.
